summary: performance lens over golden-provenance (14 product path(s), 0cca24b..8585d35, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The patch introduces a user-visible aggregation regression for valid composed selections below the natural grain, can corrupt valid component-label provenance, and adds avoidable per-row warehouse lookup amplification. No compatibility wrappers, aliases, or other prohibited leftovers are visible in the supplied diff.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Do not force hidden provenance fields into the requested aggregation grain (backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:94): Adding `month` and the provenance values to every composed query's `GROUP BY` changes existing measure semantics whenever the caller requests less than the full `(gl_code, month)` grain.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Preserve array element boundaries when collecting component labels (backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts:242): The adapter's text-array representation is comma-joined, and splitting that value on every comma cannot reconstruct valid labels that themselves contain commas; trimming also changes labels with significant surrounding whitespace.

[P2] Avoid two correlated ingest-batch lookups per financial row (backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:155): Performance inference from the generated SQL: both active-batch IDs are fetched through correlated scalar subqueries keyed by the current row's month.
